notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Krenko.
Krenko does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional Goblin.
description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing a Goblin token, targeting any artifact.
When the Goblin dies, Krenko triggers, untapping itself.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Goblin Trashmaster abilities, destroying the targeted artifact(s).
You may also repeat this loop whenever an artifact enters the battlefield.
